answer.short:
$x=\dfrac{3\pm\sqrt7}{2}$.

Use the quadratic formula with discriminant $28$.
answer.worked:
Use the quadratic formula with $a=2$, $b=-6$ and $c=1$.
$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{-(-6)\pm\sqrt{(-6)^2-4(2)(1)}}{2(2)}\\x&=\frac{6\pm\sqrt{28}}{4}\\x&=\frac{6\pm2\sqrt7}{4}\\x&=\frac{3\pm\sqrt7}{2}\end{align*}$$
